workstream: RENTipid GLOBAL-MKT / v2.0 — GLOBAL MARKETPLACE ACTIVATION
action: GM-9A Full Integrated Local Global-Marketplace Acceptance

defects.reproduction: In full integrated lifecycle execution, resolving a damage claim (via resolveClaim) or dispute (via resolveDispute) properly updated claimsById/disputesById, but did not update the secondary booking-indexed lookup map (claimsByBookingId/disputesByBookingId). Consequently, evaluatePayoutHoldStatus(bookingId) retrieved the stale SUBMITTED record and held payout indefinitely even after successful administrative adjudication.
defects.rootCause: The secondary booking index maps (claimsByBookingId, disputesByBookingId) were only populated during initial record creation and were not updated with the resolved record during lifecycle transitions.
defects.fixSummary: Added synchronous update to claimsByBookingId and disputesByBookingId upon resolveClaim, escalateClaimToDispute, and resolveDispute.
defects.reopenedChain: GM-7A Post-Transaction Integration and GM-9A Integrated Acceptance Runner
